svg.title: tsrs vs bun check vs tsgo
svg.desc: Summed over 17 TypeScript projects · 4 threads each · 16-vCPU Linux machine. Check time: tsrs 12.2 s, bun check 36.9 s, tsgo 81.9 s. Peak memory: tsrs 12.6 GiB, bun check 15.2 GiB, tsgo 53.1 GiB. Shorter is better. Per project: vscode: tsrs 2.18 s, 1.80 GiB; bun check 4.35 s, 1.51 GiB; tsgo 10.63 s, 7.50 GiB. xstate-main: tsrs 0.16 s, 0.25 GiB; bun check 0.31 s, 0.30 GiB; tsgo 0.87 s, 0.72 GiB. webpack: tsrs 0.26 s, 0.39 GiB; bun check 0.50 s, 0.37 GiB; tsgo 1.35 s, 1.15 GiB. mui-docs: tsrs 1.06 s, 1.05 GiB; bun check 9.52 s, 5.18 GiB; tsgo 12.75 s, 7.38 GiB. Compiler: tsrs 0.06 s, 0.10 GiB; bun check 0.10 s, 0.13 GiB; tsgo 0.27 s, 0.22 GiB. Compiler-Unions: tsrs 0.09 s, 0.10 GiB; bun check 0.20 s, 0.13 GiB; tsgo 0.54 s, 0.23 GiB. cal-diy: tsrs 0.95 s, 1.15 GiB; bun check 2.94 s, 0.92 GiB; tsgo 5.47 s, 4.36 GiB. formbricks-web: tsrs 1.13 s, 1.45 GiB; bun check 2.40 s, 1.33 GiB; tsgo 7.00 s, 5.86 GiB. supabase-studio: tsrs 1.21 s, 1.19 GiB; bun check 3.56 s, 0.89 GiB; tsgo 6.86 s, 4.42 GiB. t3code-server: tsrs 1.66 s, 1.18 GiB; bun check 3.77 s, 1.01 GiB; tsgo 13.81 s, 6.15 GiB. mikro-orm: tsrs 1.66 s, 1.39 GiB; bun check 5.18 s, 0.75 GiB; tsgo 11.55 s, 6.68 GiB. next-packages-next: tsrs 0.45 s, 0.55 GiB; bun check 0.96 s, 0.50 GiB; tsgo 3.10 s, 1.77 GiB. next-root: tsrs 0.30 s, 0.40 GiB; bun check 0.63 s, 0.42 GiB; tsgo 1.60 s, 1.30 GiB. storybook: tsrs 0.28 s, 0.39 GiB; bun check 0.56 s, 0.44 GiB; tsgo 1.75 s, 1.40 GiB. nuxt: tsrs 0.24 s, 0.38 GiB; bun check 0.68 s, 0.40 GiB; tsgo 1.35 s, 1.16 GiB. playwright: tsrs 0.23 s, 0.34 GiB; bun check 0.46 s, 0.37 GiB; tsgo 1.20 s, 1.05 GiB. drizzle-orm: tsrs 0.28 s, 0.50 GiB; bun check 0.75 s, 0.53 GiB; tsgo 1.80 s, 1.71 GiB. tsgo and tsrs with --checkers 4, bun check with --threads 4. Median of 10 interleaved runs (3 for tsgo). tsrs uses PGO-optimized dist build, built like the npm release binaries. Machine: Depot CI depot-ubuntu-24.04-16 (16 vCPU, 63 GB RAM, Linux x86_64, AMD EPYC 9R45 96-Core Processor). Measured 2026-10-16 07:31 UTC; tsrs commit 769cbc24b1290ee77a4a6de1b50fdcade9310293. TypeScript 7.0.2; TypeScript reference b85298b6a81f772d080b0455de0ca9d744cd6fd6.
